text:
jen: Quick PSA — the runtime guide's curl example for the /v1/models endpoint 404s when you click the example in staging.
jen: Repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/models/gpt-neo/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
jen: Getting 404 and the sample shortlink points to /docs/runtime/api.md#example which is a dead anchor.
sam: ack — good catch. which doc path is it? can you paste the exact URL?
jen: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/guide/api.md#sample-curl (404)
maria: @jen thanks — assigning to docs owners. @leo do you own runtime/guide?
leo: I can take a quick look, likely an anchor rename. will try to patch and open PR today :thumbsup: 
jen: awesome — minimal PR to update anchor or replace with inline snippet would be fine.
sam: If it's small, ping me for CR, I can merge outside of sprint.
leo: i'll create PR 8210001290 — will include updated snippet and test in staging.
docs-bot: New PR opened: #7423 by leo – docs/runtime: fix curl sample anchor -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7423
maria: thx. @jen can you smoke test the staging snippet after the PR is merged?
jen: yep will verify and report back, ETA 30m
sam: also please add a note to the runbook about canonical shortlink usage so this doesn't recur
leo: added a one-liner in PR description to add to runbook in follow-up issue
jen: PR merged and snippet renders in staging, verified curl returns 200 now :tada:
jen: leaving a tiny follow-up in docs issue to track shortlink rot
maria: closing the loop — thanks everyone!
